headlines.headline: 'The Hoop Collective': Episodes of Brian Windhorst's NBA podcast
headlines.description: Here are the top highlights from Brian Windhorst's "The Hoop Collective" podcast, from breaking news to the latest intel and reaction from around the NBA.

headlines.headline: Sources: Wembanyama lands signature shoe line in Nike deal
headlines.description: Spurs star Victor Wembanyama signed a new, long-term deal with Nike that includes a signature sneaker, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.

headlines.headline: Attorneys clash over text meaning in Rozier betting case
headlines.description: Terry Rozier's attorney argued in a court filing Friday that a text sent by a co-defendant shows the NBA veteran did not know about the alleged gambling scheme for which he has been indicted.

headlines.headline: Stacking which teams can keep the NBA's parity run going
headlines.description: The NBA has seen eight different champions in eight years. Which of the other 22 teams can make it 9-for-9, and which ones are a long way off?

headlines.headline: Egusi, Nigerians, and Ewing - Washington feels like home for Wizards rookie Felix Okpara
headlines.description: For 22-year-old center Felix Okpara, Washington is going to mean way more than the city where his NBA career begins. It is also home to one of the largest Nigerian and African communities in the United States.

headlines.headline: Blazers, Portland officials meet to discuss Moda Center revamp, lease
headlines.description: Representatives from the Trail Blazers met with Portland city councilors to discuss a new lease and the commitment of public funds to renovate the aging Moda Center.

headlines.headline: Bills safety Gardner-Johnson carted off with leg injury
headlines.description: Bills safety C.J. Gardner-Johnson was carted to the locker room after suffering a lower-body injury during Saturday's training camp practice.

headlines.headline: Sources: 49ers VP Paraag Marathe exits to focus on soccer clubs
headlines.description: 49ers executive vice president of football operations Paraag Marathe is leaving the team after 25 years to focus full time on Leeds United and Rangers FC as well as other sports efforts, league sources told ESPN.

headlines.description: Why Bijan Robinson hasn't signed a new deal with Falcons yet

headlines.headline: WR DeAndre Hopkins hired as Georgia Tech assistant WR coach
headlines.description: Five-time All-Pro wide receiver DeAndre Hopkins has joined Georgia Tech as assistant wide receivers coach but says he isn't retiring as a player yet.

headlines.headline: 'Excited' Lions welcome LaPorta back after long road from surgery
headlines.description: LaPorta is expected to be a big part of the offense under new offensive coordinator Drew Petzing.

headlines.headline: Graf stays with Sharks on 3-year deal worth $12.75 million
headlines.description: Forward Collin Graf, who had 21 goals and 25 assists in 81 games last season, re-signed with the Sharks on a three-year deal worth $12.75 million.

headlines.headline: Penguins sign veteran forward Tommy Novak to a 3-year extension
headlines.description: The Pittsburgh Penguins signed dependable forward Tommy Novak to a three-year contract extension on Friday.

headlines.headline: NHL rookie roundtable: Gavin McKenna and other top rookies answer burning questions
headlines.description: How would you want people to describe your game? Most embarrassing hockey story?  We got the answers to those questions and more from some of the NHL's top rookies.

headlines.headline: Swedish Elite League team rescinds Foote deal amid fan uproar
headlines.description: Färjestad BK of the Swedish Elite League announced Thursday it was not going to honor Cal Foote's contract after conversations with stakeholders.

headlines.headline: IIHF says Russia still from 4 world tournaments in 2027
headlines.description: The International Ice Hockey Federation said Russia will not be allowed to participate in four tournaments next year after a review by the organization's council.

headlines.headline: Vancouver Goldeneyes GM Cara Gardner Morey steps down to coach
headlines.description: Cara Gardner Morey is stepping down as the Vancouver Goldeneyes GM to fill the team's head-coaching vacancy, the PWHL announced on Thursday.
